answer_1.quote: This approach involves teaching LLMs to directly generate suitable item representations (e.g., item titles) as recommendations based on given instructions.
answer_1.outputs: item titles or semantic IDs as recommendations

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the model's top-K recommendation performance (accuracy), we use two commonly used metrics: Hit Ratio (HR@K) and Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain (NDCG@K)
